{{Top|leg}}
'''Plasma cloud''' was a dessert considered to be a specialty of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The dessert was a fusion of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] and [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] cuisines created during the cultural mingling of the two peoples that occurred in the wake of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Plasma cloud recipes required carefully infusing the egg whites of the [[Pikobi/Legends|Pikobi]], a flightless avian native to Naboo, with [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] mined from the planet. When properly prepared, the resulting dish was considered light and refreshing.
